**Roasted Mirelurk Meat** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Mirelurk Meat which has been cooked, improving its nutritional value and reducing the amount of radiation it confers upon the player character. Consuming it will heal the player character and increase their maximum Action Points by 10 for a short period.
